_comment: Words that give away a sentence about the model's governance, about the method, or about the document itself. A model page speaks about its subject; the rest lives in AGENTS.md, the contributing guide, the model's front door or the status line. Regular expressions; case is ignored unless a pattern opens with (?-i:. A project in another language translates this file and keeps check_prose.py identical to the scaffold's.
document: \b(?:this layer|the layer) (?:is derived|motivates|has no elements|is filled)\b
